theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let finite original-index sets $B,A$ be enumerated bijectively by physical arrays of lengths $N_L,N_R$, and let $q$ be a global output for local size $h$ and block count $J$. Suppose both two-modulus source histograms, the selected occurrence indices, and complete cover input are stored. For cutoff $c\le464hJ$, assume the full ordered mask/coefficient/hash/flag/stage/scratch layout and the exact helper, space, word, and depth requirements. The retained host constructs all compact zeta stages of the semantic left and right source functions for modulus $p$ and signed shift, preserving memory below the mask destination within the stated time.
